models.name: placement_v3
models.architecture: beat-grid transformer encoder (4 layers, d=192, 8 heads), FiLM(bpm,stars) + diagnostic head, EMA
models.output: [B, T_beats, 48] event logits (note heads + hold tails)

models.name: selection_v3
models.architecture: 2-layer LSTM (h=512) over [audio ctx, 16-event history emb, cond], scheduled sampling, EMA
models.input: per-event audio window (±2 beats) + prev 16 combos + phase/IOI/cond

models.name: placement_mert
models.architecture: frozen MERT-v1-95M encoder (13-layer mean-pooled, per-beat 8x768) + LayerNorm/Linear projection + beat-grid transformer encoder (4 layers, d=192, 8 heads), FiLM(bpm,stars) + diagnostic head, EMA
models.input: [B, T_beats, 8, 768] per-beat MERT units (precomputed offline; encoder frozen, not in checkpoint)
models.output: [B, T_beats, 48] event logits (note heads + hold tails)
models.notes: selection beats v3 (combo acc 0.440 vs 0.433 val); placement still below v3 (0.678 test)

models.name: selection_mert
models.architecture: 2-layer LSTM (h=512) over [MERT units 5 beats x 8 x 768, 16-event history emb, cond], scheduled sampling, EMA
models.input: per-event MERT unit window (±2 beats) + prev 16 combos + phase/IOI/cond

models.name: placement_raw
models.architecture: raw-waveform SampleCNN frontend (4-stage 1D conv, GroupNorm+GELU, ~0.2M) + beat-grid transformer encoder (4 layers, d=192, 8 heads), FiLM(bpm,stars) + diagnostic head, EMA
models.input: [B, T_beats, 4096] per-beat raw waveform (int16, per-set p95-normalized, anti-alias low-passed)
models.output: [B, T_beats, 48] event logits (note heads + hold tails)

models.name: selection_raw
models.architecture: 2-layer LSTM (h=512) over [raw-frontend beat embeddings (5 beats x 8 x 128), 16-event history emb, cond], scheduled sampling, EMA
models.input: per-event raw-embedding window (±2 beats) + prev 16 combos + phase/IOI/cond
